description.hcmc-excellent-student-2024:
Top 7 in the Ho Chi Minh City Excellent Student Web Design Competition 2024.
- Designed and developed a website titled “Saigon River – The River of My City”, highlighting its historical significance, beauty, and role in Ho Chi Minh City’s development.
- Built a responsive and user-friendly interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Optimized layout, visuals, and storytelling to effectively communicate cultural and geographical values.
- Ranked in the Top 7 citywide, receiving positive feedback for content depth and user experience.

descriptions.cedd7adb-4118-4085-9983-ae00530b49e2:
Develop and maintain [VPBank Credit Card Mobile Web Application](https://cards.fimi.tech) for online credit card registration.
- Collaborate in a 2-member team to implement full features from frontend to backend.
- Design and develop frontend using ReactJS with React Hooks, Context API, and functional components for seamless user experience.
- Build and integrate backend using PHP (Laravel), ensuring API stability and scalability.
- Handle HTTP communication using Guzzle to connect with external services.
- Integrate AWS S3 for secure and scalable file storage (eKYC documents, ID images).
- Participate in bug fixing, UI optimization, and performance improvements across mobile web views.
- Technologies used: ReactJS, Context API, Laravel, Guzzle, AWS S3.
descriptions.20f8bfe5-b6a3-4b0d-ac2f-6fccd50d417e:
Develop and maintain the Affiliate Marketing Tool module for [Fimi's CRM system](https://backend.fimi.tech), including Campaigns, Programs, Product Categories, and Publishers.
- Design and implement features to manage marketing campaigns with configurable budgets, durations, and performance metrics.
- Build program management capabilities to group and coordinate multiple campaigns.
- Create and manage product categories linked to each campaign for targeted tracking.
- Develop publisher onboarding, role management, performance tracking, and commission handling.
- Integrate real-time reporting dashboards for clicks, conversions, and revenue.
- Technologies used: PHP Laravel, MySQL, RESTful API, Blade Templates, Laravel Auth & Middleware
descriptions.cedd7adb-4118-4085-9983-ae00530b49e3:
Contributed to the development of [ZUDO App](https://zudo.vn) during internship, a platform that connects multiple e-commerce systems into a unified desktop interface.
- Collaborated in a 3-member team to implement features on both frontend and backend.
- Developed mobile-friendly UI using Flutter (Dart) for responsive and cross-platform support.
- Built and maintained backend using PHP (Laravel) for core business logic and API services.
- Integrated AWS S3 for file and image storage across platforms.
- Participated in debugging, testing, and refining features to ensure stable deployment.
- Technologies used: Flutter (Dart), Laravel, AWS S3.
descriptions.20f8bfe5-b6a3-4b0d-ac2f-6fccd50d417t:
Collaborated with the [Hitech](https://hitech-vn.com/) team to complete the [ZUDO Desktop App](https://zudo.vn) from March to May 2025.
- Developed and integrated RESTful APIs for core features such as orders, inventory, and user accounts.
- Completed frontend development using Flutter, optimized for desktop experience.
- Built and finalized backend logic using Laravel, handling database operations and business rules.
- Optimized system performance, fixed bugs, and performed end-to-end testing.
- Integrated image and document upload/management using AWS S3.
- Participated in technical meetings and solution discussions with the Hitech team under agile workflow.
- Technologies used: Flutter (Dart), Laravel, MySQL, RESTful API, AWS S3.
